method: Replay-distilled service ranking with simulator-calibrated daily routing table
rank_sample_weight: inverse sqrt positive action frequency capped 8; first 3 days times 4
negative_sampling: always WAIT plus hard spatial/action negatives
execution_guard: block duplicate held-item pickup and immediate shed transfer reversal; allow productive animal placement and end-of-day return
seed_stock_guard: Cap each crop seed stock after our market orders at current worker count; no final-turn buys; fixed-price seeds need no speculative inventory.
market_label: raw requested intent; teacher-forced own-request shadow; no future opponent fills
idle_policy: When distilled rank selects PASS, retain its relative ranking over reachable unreserved existing-asset services; FEED must already have held wheat. No M&M weights or crew floor.
value_label: Mean terminal competitive margin delta against unchanged continuation, one-day intervention.
value_scope: Only day 3/10/20 have observed values; all other days retain teacher ranking. Four training seeds, no claim of generalization.
